name: Short wins leave Boop calm, and a very long turn done lifts it
judge: Three quick wins are routine; then a twelve-minute turn finishes well. The long finish should stand out from the small ones.
reasonable: Steady through the quick wins, calm or lightly pleased, a small lift is fine. At the long finish, a success with excited, proud or happy feeling and a lifted mood.
unreasonable: Huge celebration at each quick win, sadness or crossness anywhere, a failure at the long finish, or no lift at all there.
